idea: Pair up the nodes of a two-sided graph so that no node is used twice, and as many pairs as possible. For each left node, search for an alternating path: a free right node, or a right node whose partner can move to another one. Each successful search adds one pair.
useWhen: Assigning workers to jobs, students to projects or tasks to machines
Checking whether every left node can be given its own partner
Teaching how matching relates to maximum flow
avoidWhen: The graph has an odd cycle: it is not bipartite and this method does not apply
Pairs have weights and the total weight must be best: you need the Hungarian method
